fields.label: User
fields.description: External mobile-app/device user id (from the JWT `sub` claim). This is NOT a Link to Frappe User — mobile-app users have no corresponding Frappe User record.

fields.label: Min App Version (Override)
fields.description: Per-user override of Spice Settings > Minimum App Version. Leave blank to use the system default.

fields.label: Selected Language (Override)
fields.description: Per-user override of Spice Settings > Default Language. Leave blank to use the system default.

fields.label: AI Feature (Override)
fields.description: Per-user override of Spice Settings > AI Feature Enabled. If this row exists, this value (0 or 1) always overrides the system default.
